title: Nathaniel Jackson
clean_html:
Nathaniel Jackson

Preserved Primary Document • jacksonn.htm

Nathaniel Jackson was the son of Wesley Jackson and his wife, Elizabeth. He was born probably in Northwest Fork Hundred, Sussex Co., DE in c. 1850 and died in 1934. Nathaniel appears with his family in the 1860 De census records, age 10. In the 1870 census he is shown, age 19, with an occupation listed as "works on farm". He married Lucy Perkins (1853-1936) and moved to Seaford, DE. This may have been the branch that lead Weslager to refer to the Jackson family as having originated in Seaford. Lucy was the daughter of Wingate and Doretor Perkins. Nathaniel and Lucy had the following children: Lulu Jackson (1876-1962) Clarence Jackson (1878-1941) married Ellen S. Perkins (1886-1966) both are buried at the Jackson/Perkins Cemetary children: Aldie Jackson Gladys Jackson (1906-1964) who married Lawrence Muntz Jenny Jackson (1922-1955) photos of Clarence and Ellen curtesy of Wythena Muntz Bessie Jackson (1886-1954) married Elijah Desoto Thomas (1887-1977) Children: Ralph Carter Thomas (1914- 1995) who married Katherine Newlin Philip H. Jackson (Nov. 15, 1888- June 10, 1960) who married Bertha Mabel Carey (Dec. 15, 1895 - Feb. 15, 1966) both are buried at the Jackson/Perkins Cemetary Children: Harland I. Jackson (1925-1985) Hazel Jackson Herman R. Jackson (Aug 5, 1915-June 5, 1969) buried at the Jackson/Perkins Cemetary Clifford Jackson (1919-1972) buried at the Jackson/Perkins Cemetary Philip A. Jackson (June 27, 1920- Aug 17, 1964) buried at the Jackson/Perkins Cemetary Norman H. Jackson (Jan 16, 1926- Jan 30, 1984) married Ruth both are buried at the Jackson/Perkins Cemetary Mattie Jackson Nora Jackson (April 5, 1893-Nov. 1, 1980) who married: Frazier CARNEY, son of William Carney & Sarah Mosley Children: Ethel Carney Lucy Carney (1888- ) William Morgan, son of Napoleon Morgan & Henrietta Durham Nora Jackson & Will Morgan Ira Woodrow Jackson who married Winifred Louise Clark. They lived in Alloway, Salem Co., NJ Their children: Lucy Margaret Jackson Ethel M. Jackson John Jackson Edward Jackson Hazel Jackson Lucy Jackson Margie Jackson Nathaniel and Lucy and many of this family are buried at the Jackson/Perkins Cemetery in Middleford, DE.
